## REST namespaces

`acf`, `rankmath`, `yoast`, `wc`, `elementor`, `wpml`). Cross-referenced in
`03-plugins-theme.md`.


## What REST cannot see here

- **The exact WordPress core version** — see the approximate note above. Also: PHP,
  MySQL/MariaDB, and web-server versions; the OS/server stack.
- **`wp-config.php` constants** (`WP_DEBUG`, `WP_MEMORY_LIMIT`, `DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT`,
  table prefix, salts) — none of these are REST-readable.
- **Most of `wp_options`** — only the handful of fields `/wp/v2/settings` whitelists
  appear above; the rest of the options table (plugin settings, theme mods, transients)
  is invisible to REST.
- **Server timezone vs site timezone** beyond the `gmt_offset` shown.
